# Anthony C. Perry

> Independent researcher and engineer working in human-AI interaction, AI safety, and adaptive learning systems. M.S. Computer Science (AI/ML), M.S. Kinesiology. USAF veteran (C-17 loadmaster). Founder of Meridian Labs (meridianlabs.us) — 28 exam-prep apps built on a confidence-calibrated adaptive learning engine. Seeking PhD positions beginning 2027.

- [About](https://aperry938.github.io/about.html): Biography — Air Force, kinesiology, computational transition
